about.title: About TASHIRA
about.body: TASHIRA is a private visa assistance service that helps travellers prepare and submit UAE visa applications. We are not a government website or government authority, and visa decisions are made solely by the relevant authorities. Our role is to make the application journey clear, accurate and supported end to end.

editorial.title: Editorial Policy
editorial.body: Our guides and news are written from official sources, reviewed before publication, and re-verified on a regular cycle. We never guarantee visa approval and we never present ourselves as a government body. Every news item names its source authority and shows the date it was last verified. If rules change, we update the guide and record the change in the item history.

sources.title: Sources & Verification
sources.body: We rely on official UAE government channels (such as ICP and GDRFA) and airline/authority publications as primary sources. Each guide lists its source authority and the date of last verification. News items older than 90 days are automatically queued for re-verification before they remain published.
